constraints.description: Automatic/default execution must not exceed 100 Valkey nodes.
constraints.name: default_node_cap

constraints.description: Runtime image must declare a Valkey 9.1.x tag.
constraints.name: valkey_version

constraints.description: Configs must require sandbox networking and forbid host network mutation.
constraints.name: sandbox_network

constraints.description: 1000-node configs require allow_1000_nodes, opt_in_1000, dry_run_only, and runtime.dry_run.
constraints.name: scale_1000_opt_in

constraints.description: Enabled workloads must have read_ratio + write_ratio equal to 1.0.
constraints.name: workload_ratios
